capabilities: Render flowcharts, sequence, activity, state, mind map, Gantt, C4, class and ER diagrams from YAML
Animate packets along arrows with per-step timing
Present storyboard scenes with per-element visibility, opacity and colors
Edit diagrams with live preview, autocomplete and error checks
disambiguation: Not a general animation or motion-graphics tool; it only draws diagrams defined in YAML code blocks inside notes.
extras: Installed by building from source with Node.js; the optional draw.io and Monaco editors download files on first enable, which needs a network connection once. Mobile use and full optional-editor workflows still need manual checks.
problem: Static diagrams in notes cannot show how requests travel through a system, where work waits, or where the bottleneck is.

relations.evidence: Use the familiar Mermaid or PlantUML style.
Use the familiar Mermaid or PlantUML style.
The optional draw.io editor is downloaded from its upstream project when you turn it on

summary: Renders animated, event-driven architecture and process diagrams from YAML in flowmotion code blocks, fully offline.
